package.description: A CAD application built with Rust — 2D/3D drawing, DWG/DXF support, and GPU-accelerated rendering.

en-US.description: A CAD application built with Rust — 2D/3D drawing, DWG/DXF support, and GPU-accelerated rendering.
en-US.name: Open CAD Studio
en-US.releaseNotes:
OpenCADStudio - Release v2026.44 (2026-11-01)
> Summary: Moved the drawing database onto the shared OpenCADDocument model with IFCX open/save and converter-based interchange; overhauled dimensions, multileaders, text editing, tables and layer workflows; redesigned the ribbon and command search; expanded the plugin host, automation and MCP surfaces; and delivered broad plotting, import, snapping, localization and performance improvements.
🌟 Notable Release Notes
- Shared Document Model & Interchange: Moved the drawing database onto the shared OpenCADDocument model, added IFCX open/save, and routed additional formats through registered converters. Before a save that would drop converter-reported content, the app lists the losses and lets you return or continue. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
- Dimension and Annotation Overhaul: Completed the DIM command family with DIMOVERRIDE, DIMDISASSOCIATE, DIMREASSOCIATE, DCDISPLAY, DIMREGEN, DIMCENTER, DIMINSPECT, DIMTMOVE, DIMBREAK and style application; saved dimension pictures, annotative sizing, flip-arrow flags and user-arrow blocks now round-trip. (Contributed by @ramox81 and @HakanSeven12)
- Multileader Overhaul: Added full MLEADER command prompts, layer and property editing, grips, edit and align/collect workflows, block-content placement, add/remove leader actions and safe explosion. (Contributed by @ramox81 and @HakanSeven12)
- MTEXT Editor Rewrite: The editor now patches the raw MTEXT source, with superscript/subscript buttons, one-sided ^ stacks, glyph-box and fraction fixes, typing in the height/oblique/width/tracking fields, undo/redo, and arc-aligned text spacing, alignment and reading direction. (Contributed by @turbuczn and @HakanSeven12)
- Ribbon and Command Search Redesign: Rebuilt the ribbon, menus and command search, including key tips, language-following labels, saved layer states in the layer dropdown, and search that offers only commands that exist. (Contributed by @MarcelP102, @HakanSeven12 and @saadmooh)
- Tables and Data Extraction: Added table property grips, command-line table workflows, an Annotate tables panel, cell text fonts, table-copy pictures and extraction table sizing and format parity. (Contributed by @ramox81 and @insanedps)
- Layer Workflows: Added LAYWALK and the non-modal LayerWalk pallet, LAYISO/LAYUNISO, nested-attribute LAYMGR, COPYTOLAYER, HATCHLAYER/XREFLAYER, per-viewport layer colour and active-viewport columns. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi, @lpotharn, @HakanSeven12 and @insanedps)
- Plugin Host and API 14: Plugins no longer need the host's compiler or codec commit, and the host gained filtered/paged entity queries, one undo step across messages, shared-memory sizing, headless worker-thread requests, REST document_id targeting, system-variable reads and bundled plugin installation. Plugin class objects with host-evaluated display descriptors and class parameter schemas extend the parametric surface through API v16. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12 and @schoeller)
- Automation and MCP: Added intent tools for common agent workflows, an MCP node_graph op backed by a standalone graph engine, schema-digest pinning and conformance checks, and print_all automation. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi and @HakanSeven12)
- Plotting and File Fidelity: Plots print at true size, plot-to-file opens the viewer, layout page setups report 1:1, PDF import joins segments by endpoint lookup, DGN reads every element of large meshes, and STEP export merges coplanar triangles into one planar face. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12 and @ramox81)
- Performance and Localization: Indexed hatch boundary edges, cached grid overlays per pane, memoized rendered labels, indexed paper views once per epoch, and streamed STL and de-quadratic STEP grouping, alongside refreshed Hungarian, Turkish, Arabic and French strings. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi, @ramox81, @turbuczn and @saadmooh)
🚀 New Features
Document Model & File Interchange
- Shared Model Migration: Moved the drawing onto the shared OpenCADDocument model and adopted its drawing variables, image/wipeout geometry, codec explode paths and hatch areas. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
- IFCX Open and Save: Added IFCX open/save carrying blocks, texts, ellipses, solids and stored dimension pictures. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
- Converter Interchange: Open and save supported external formats through registered converters, with an explicit review of content a conversion cannot preserve. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
- Drawing Properties (DWGPROPS): Added a Drawing Properties dialog with a read-only General tab, an editable Summary tab and a custom-property table; OK stores one undo step and save formats that cannot carry properties warn first. (Contributed by @sclMAX)
- Recovery Diagnostics: Recovery reports name the acadrust commit the reader was built from. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
- Save Format: Saving keeps the format of the drawing's own file. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
Dimensions, Text & Multileaders
- Dimension Commands: Added DIMOVERRIDE, DIMDISASSOCIATE, DIMREASSOCIATE, DCDISPLAY, QPMODE, DIMREGEN, DIMCENTER, DIMINSPECT, DIMBREAK prompts and DIMSTYLE application, with dedicated ribbon rows and inspection values. (Contributed by @ramox81 and @HakanSeven12)
- Dimension Pictures and Sizing: Saved pictures match line breaks and two-line angles, annotative sizes follow the scale's own ratio, flip-arrow flags draw and save, and user-arrow blocks are honored. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
- DIMTMOVE and Overrides: DIMTMOVE measures text only when the user placed it, angular text width and baseline DIMDLI behave, and overrides rewrite in place and accept BYBLOCK/BYLAYER colours. (Contributed by @ramox81)
- Multileader: Added command prompts, layer, properties, grips, edit, align/collect, block content from the content base point, lowest-free leader index, context-menu add/remove leader, and explosion. (Contributed by @ramox81 and @HakanSeven12)
- Text Editor: Edit the raw MTEXT source, superscript/subscript buttons, one-sided stacks, height/oblique/width/tracking typing, input method in the preview, Ctrl+Z/Y, and command-line font/size in Options. (Contributed by @turbuczn and @HakanSeven12)
- Arc-Aligned Text: Added spacing, alignment and reading-direction controls. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
- Fields: Object, block and text properties resolve in the codec, additional formats and point coordinates are kept, custom drawing properties resolve, and a field text opens its field for editing. (Contributed by @ftaski and @HakanSeven12)
- Style Import: Import text and dimension styles from another drawing, repointing dimension styles as a paste does and translating the imported strings. (Contributed by @turbuczn)
Tables, Blocks & Constraints
- Table Workflows: Added table property grips, command-line table commands, an Annotate tables panel, cell text fonts, table-copy pictures and extraction table sizing and format parity. (Contributed by @ramox81 and @insanedps)
- Block Editor: Parameter previews now draw polar as a dashed circle with an arrowed arc, XY drives from its endpoint, rotation takes a base angle, alignment defaults to perpendicular, grip counts and labels are asked, Lookup appears in the action list, and visibility/lookup pickers float in Test Block. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi and @HakanSeven12)
- Constraints: Added dedicated geometric constraint command names, tangency and parallel picks that hold the first line, repeat-last, dimensional-form conversion, invalid-pick refusal and flagged-constraint names on entity reads. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi)
- Associative Path Arrays: Added associative path arrays with ARRAYPATH DIVIDE/MEASURE methods and member extension dictionaries and reactors. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12 and @insanedps)
- ATTSYNC and Attributes: ATTSYNC reaches dynamic references through their definition, and attribute definitions and values stay consistent through insert, copy and edit. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12 and @insanedps)
Layers, Selection & Navigation
- Layer Walk: LAYWALK opens the non-modal pallet with wildcard filters, hold, purge, layer-state capture, zoom to extents and selection. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi)
- Layer Isolation: Added LAYISO/LAYUNISO with lock-only and fade behavior, plus localized icons. (Contributed by @lpotharn)
- Layer Tools: Added COPYTOLAYER, HATCHLAYER, XREFLAYER, nested-attribute LAYMGR, per-viewport layer colour and active-viewport columns. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12 and @insanedps)
- Selection and Snapping: SELECTSIMILAR settings and SELECTSIMILARMODE, OSNAPZ elevation projection, Nearest off by default, nearest-snap under the cursor, OSNAP capture-radius range and snap markers in Drafting Settings. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12 and @insanedps)
- Navigation: CATIA and FreeCAD navigation styles, Alt+click ViewCube to set UCS, Shift axis lock, Shift during middle-button pan, Ctrl+R next viewport, CHSPACE target prompts and ZOOM Window ignoring snaps. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
Interface, Options & Platform
- Ribbon and Menus: Redesigned ribbon, menus and command search, key tips, language-following labels, saved layer states in the dropdown, and classic menu placement. (Contributed by @MarcelP102, @HakanSeven12 and @saadmooh)
- Options and Dialogs: Support-files folder, Restore Defaults, command-line font/size, Cmd+, on macOS, RENAME, PURGE, a start-page template picker and Options returning to Options. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
- Colour and Appearance: Recently picked colours, index-colour picking, canvas-aware colour 7, Windows typographic font families and background-following block-editor ink. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
- Quick Properties and Docking: Draggable Quick Properties with QPLOCATION, one-line layer names and Ctrl+1 for tucked-away panels. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
